notes.title: Act 1 Update
notes.notes:
Act 1 received an update to reflect all changes we did to it while making Act 2. 

 The most significant one being the proofreading and fixing all the typos. We had some really beautiful and dedicated people helping us to polish our words and they are listed in the credits. 
 A new saving system (coded by Ayael of the Imperial Grace game)
 There is a new visual for death scene, some changes to the choices, a new scene art and a new letter.
Thank you so much for your support and for being part of our journey.

May the Currents take you where you're meant to be.

- Ze and Nim

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where gallery items were mistakenly unlocked from the start.
 Fixed a number of minor grammatical mistakes.
Fixed Fan Pack not being downloaded when purchased.
 Channelled mysterious energies into the game with my MIND.


EDIT: The hotfix caused Steam to no longer find the .exe This has now been fixed.
